subject: dsa
title: Count Good Nodes in Binary Tree
summary: A node is good if nothing on the path from the root down to it is larger. Walk down each path carrying the largest value seen so far; a node is good when it is at least that running maximum.
problem: Count the nodes in a binary tree that are good: no node on the path from the root to them holds a greater value.

steps.caption: A node is good if no node on the path from the root is greater than it. Carry the max-so-far down each path and compare.
The root 3 is always good — nothing sits above it. The running max starts at 3.
Go left to 1: the path max is 3 and 1 < 3, so this node is not good.
Below it, 3 ties the path max of 3. Nothing on the path is greater, so it counts as good.
Go right to 4: 4 >= 3, so it's good and raises the path max to 4.
Under 4: the 1 is below the path max so it's not good, but 5 >= 4 is good. Good nodes total 4: the root, the lower 3, 4, and 5.
